name: work
description: Bind each Slate git worktree to a Linear issue, so a session knows what it is working on from where it sits and Linear stays current without being maintained by hand. Start work from a ticket or from nothing; a binding is proposed from the branch and confirmed by a person. Only a confirmed binding permits a write, and writes are bounded in code to the bound issue and what the plugin created beneath it, because a personal Linear key carries the whole account. Hooks do nothing until a worktree is bound. Every write ships in shadow mode until a logged proposal has been checked against a real issue.
